(2) The driver's contract, one sentence each with anchor text pasted (no line numbers) from factory-task, factory-review, factory-integrate, factory-dispatch and factory-wave: FACTORY_PLAN has no default in factory-task (it dies without it); factory-review falls back from a plan: metadata line to FACTORY_PLAN, dying if neither is set. The FACTORY-RESULT grammar accepted is a line matching status=(done|partial|failed), last one wins; absent that, it synthesizes status=unreported when commits exist or status=failed when they don't. factory-integrate merges each task/<KEY> branch with git merge --no-ff, fetched from that key's own workspace clone, in the given order into integ/<run>, refusing a key with no shared merge base against the default branch or one whose .result shows undeclared extra touched files without a stated reason. dispatch.log is written at $FACTORY_RUNS/<run>/dispatch.log, and each launched wave appends one line naming the run, plan and groups. A hand/direct launch (no seat-submit resolvable via $SEAT_SUBMIT or PATH) must explicitly set FACTORY_SEAT_UNIT=0 to use the non-broker arm, or factory-task refuses. factory-wave was read but added no distinct contract fact beyond these.
